turns.query: For 2025 Q3, form one common country population having BIS private-nonfinancial-sector actual credit-to-GDP ratios and actual-minus-trend credit gaps under all-lender coverage, together with BIS private-nonfinancial-sector debt-service ratios. Within that same population, rank the three measures separately from highest to lowest, using country-name alphabetical order to resolve an exact value tie. Report the common-country count and each measure's leading country and value. Also report the actual-ratio leader's ordinal credit-gap rank and the credit-gap leader's ordinal actual-ratio and debt-service-ratio ranks, with rank 1 denoting the highest value. Use four decimals for credit ratios and gaps, one decimal for debt-service ratios, and explain what the ranking pattern does and does not imply about credit burden.
